steps.summary: On RD-1019's detail page I deleted both parts through the row Delete buttons, confirming each in-page "Confirm" dialog ("Delete part"); the parts table refreshed after each delete and now reads exactly "No parts on this ticket yet." with no total row rendered at all (tfoot count 0). Clicking "Archive ticket" was accepted with no error and no confirmation prompt — the button changed to "Unarchive ticket" — leaving the ticket's final status "Ready" with an "Archived" flag on the detail page. In the main tickets list it is hidden by default (search for RD-1019 with Show archived off returns "No tickets match the current filters.") but appears with the "Show archived" filter on as "RD-1019 | fwrd74-n3 RD Bench Ticket Archived [Archived] | Bench Customer Ltd | Ready | 0 | 2026-09-17".
